offering_description.value: Rents natural gas compression units to oil and gas producers and gas gathering operators. It designs and builds compressor packages, services its rental fleet in the field, and sells units and parts.

primary_products.value: Packaged natural gas compression units; compressor replacement parts

primary_services.value: Natural gas compressor rental; field maintenance and repair; compressor overhauls

customer_segment.value: B2B: Oil and gas producers and natural gas gathering operators

end_markets.value: Oil and gas production; natural gas gathering

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: Use of natural gas compression units under rental contracts; product sales: Packaged compressor units and replacement parts; service fees: Maintenance, repairs and overhauls for customer-owned compressors
revenue_model.category: rental or leasing; product sales; service fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: Owns and maintains a fleet of compression units rented to producers and gathering operators; OEM / manufacturer: Builds compressor packages from engines, compressors and controls for oil and gas operators; service provider: Maintains and repairs customer-owned compression equipment for oil and gas operators
value_chain_position.category: asset operator; OEM / manufacturer; service provider

geography_served.value: US regional: Permian Basin in Texas and New Mexico and other U.S. oil and gas producing regions

specialization.value: related lines: Compressor rentals, equipment fabrication, replacement parts and field service

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Direct rental contracts, equipment sales and field service for oil and gas operators

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: EPA and state air emissions rules for compressor engines and OSHA workplace safety standards

notes: The current footprint outside the Permian Basin is uncertain.
